{{Quote|Step right up, my friend. I have a proposition for you. During this Festival that celebrates Love and Romance, there are those who lack someone to share their life. You can help change that. Are you interested?|L-O53 to an unknown spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''L-O53''' was a matchmaking [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].

==Biography==
[[File:LO53Big.jpg|thumb|left|230px|L-O53 in Tyrena]]
L-O53 participated in the [[Festival of Love|Ewok Festival of Love]]. He would task [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] and [[Kaadara]] to pair up a variety of individuals based on their similar interests.

Unlike most protocol droids, L-O53 was painted in such way that he appeared to be wearing a tuxedo.

==Behind the scenes==
L-O53 is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Ever since the Festival of Love event in [[2009]], he has made appearances during each yearly event. During these events, players can speak to L-O53 and receive a task to help pair up NPC couples.
